"""Build a planted merge history: build.py DEST DECISIONS COMMITS SIDE MAIN [REVISE_EVERY]
Blocks of SIDE side commits, MAIN main commits and one merge. Every REVISE_EVERY-th block's first side commit
revises a decision (owner); every 7th such revision is an engineer's (unapproved) instead. Some merges also
revise a decision on main side so merges are read."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys

dest, decisions, commits, side, main = sys.argv[1], *map(int, sys.argv[2:6])
revise_every = int(sys.argv[6]) if len(sys.argv) > 6 else 3
env = {"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "HOME": dest + "-home", "LC_ALL": "C", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1",
       "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": os.devnull}
os.makedirs(dest)
os.makedirs(dest + "-home", exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", dest], check=True, env=env)
stream, state = [], {"mark": 0, "now": 1_792_000_000}


def commit(ref, message, files, parent=None, merge=None):
    state["mark"] += 1
    state["now"] += 1
    data = message.encode()
    stream.append(f"commit refs/heads/{ref}\nmark :{state['mark']}\ncommitter F <f@x.invalid> {state['now']} +0000\n"
                  f"data {len(data)}\n{message}\n")
    if parent is not None:
        stream.append(f"from :{parent}\n")
    if merge is not None:
        stream.append(f"merge :{merge}\n")
    for rel, text in files.items():
        stream.append(f"M 100644 inline {rel}\ndata {len(text.encode())}\n{text}\n")
    stream.append("\n")
    return state["mark"]


def text(n, r):
    return f"---\nid: DEC-{n:03d}\ntype: decision\nstatus: ACTIVE\ntitle: D{n}\n---\nrev {r}\n"


rev = {}
head = None
for n in range(1, decisions + 1):
    rev[n] = 0
    head = commit("main", f"decision {n}\n\nRole: owner", {f"docs/adr/DEC-{n:03d}.md": text(n, 0)}, parent=head)
blocks = (commits - decisions) // (side + main + 1)
revisions = 0
for b in range(blocks):
    fork, tip, side_files = head, head, {}
    for s in range(side):
        if s == 0 and b % revise_every == 0:
            n = (b * 7 % decisions) + 1
            rev[n] += 1
            revisions += 1
            role = "engineer" if revisions % 7 == 0 else "owner"
            files = {f"docs/adr/DEC-{n:03d}.md": text(n, rev[n])}
            tip = commit("side", f"revise {n}\n\nRole: {role}", files, parent=tip)
        else:
            files = {f"src/s{(b * side + s) % 50}.txt": f"{b} {s}\n"}
            tip = commit("side", f"side {b} {s}\n\nRole: engineer", files, parent=tip)
        side_files.update(files)
    for m in range(main):
        head = commit("main", f"main {b} {m}\n\nRole: engineer", {f"src/m{(b * main + m) % 50}.txt": f"{b} {m}\n"},
                      parent=head)
    head = commit("main", f"Merge {b}\n\nRole: engineer", side_files, parent=head, merge=tip)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", dest, "fast-import", "--quiet", "--force"], input="".join(stream).encode(), check=True,
               env=env)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", dest, "update-ref", "-d", "refs/heads/side"], check=True, env=env)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", dest, "reset", "-q", "--hard", "main"], check=True, env=env)
print("built", state["mark"], "commits", blocks, "merges", revisions, "revisions")

The empty-diff merge gets one header and is listed with no paths, which is right because its tree equals both parents. The git output shows one header per parent for a merge, and `--no-renames` lists a move as a delete plus an add. A merge with no header is not listed, so it is read in full (fails safe).
